notes: Every method a test calls must exist on its page object — add it in the same reply. The harness starts each test with an empty cart. An add control is REPLACED by a remove control once clicked, so never assert that the add button changed its text. The badge does not exist at all at zero items.

The detail page's add-to-cart control is REPLACED by a separate remove control once clicked — assert that the remove control appears and the add control is gone, never that one element changed its text.

The form validates EVERY required field on submit, so a partial fill still shows the other fields' alerts. Assert only on the alert for the field under test; never assert that another field's alert is absent unless that field was filled. Never submit a registration that would create an account.

The product-name selector matches every card on the page, so a singular assertion on it raises a Playwright strict-mode violation — chain .first where the attribute is defined, or assert to_have_count. The sort control takes the option values name,asc / name,desc / price,desc / price,asc.
